description: SplashScout finds family water-holiday hotels and campsites and scores each one for the ages travelling — toddlers, kids and teens — based on pools, slides, splash zones, kids' clubs and guest reviews. It returns interactive cards with per-age scores, water features, guest ratings and booking links.
